analysis.session_summary: US-Iran diplomacy dominated the window: Iran's Supreme Leader granted authority for talks, Brent/USD fell 7.41%, Gold/USD rose 2.26%, and headlines whipsawed risk FX. The dollar failed to sustain its ISM Manufacturing PMI beat (55.5 vs 54.5), gaining only 0.053% on the release and closing lower on the session. CHF led majors at +0.641%, EUR +0.393%, while AUD was weakest at -0.351% after an early gain was rejected. The tape shows haven demand and EUR outperformance against a soft USD and commodity FX.

currency_drivers.USD: ISM beat failed to generate durable dollar strength; closed lower as risk flows favored havens.
currency_drivers.EUR: No own catalyst; outperformed on soft dollar and haven demand.
currency_drivers.JPY: No own catalyst; weakened as risk appetite improved, funding currency sold.
currency_drivers.GBP: No own catalyst; modestly firmer with no domestic data.
currency_drivers.AUD: No own catalyst; early gain rejected, weakest into RBA risk.
currency_drivers.CAD: No own catalyst; weak with oil and commodity FX despite brief ISM dip.
currency_drivers.CHF: No own catalyst; strengthened as haven while US-Iran headlines whipsawed risk.
currency_drivers.NZD: No own catalyst; soft with commodity complex, no domestic drivers.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD's early 79.5-pip rally had no clear catalyst, and its later 32.0-pip pullback saw ISM contribute only 25% of the leg, leaving euro-driven strength dominant.

polarity_reads.read: The 55.5 vs 54.5 beat produced only a 0.053% USD gain, with USD/SEK +0.086% leading and USD/CAD -4.4 pips; this indicates crowded short-dollar positioning was only partly unwound.

scenarios.name: Dollar soft, risk-positive trading
scenarios.thesis: US-Iran diplomacy continues, ISM beat fails to revive dollar, and risk assets stay supported; CHF and EUR remain firm while commodity FX stabilize.
scenarios.invalidation: Iran talks collapse or US data/headlines revive dollar strength.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR strength 0.393% and USD softness support a grind higher.
CHF haven demand persists, USD no catalyst.
RBA risk passes without hawkish surprise, AUD rebounds from weakest level.

scenarios.name: RBA hawkish hike lifts AUD
scenarios.thesis: RBA raises cash rate to 4.85% as forecast and signals further tightening, forcing short covering in beaten-down AUD.
scenarios.invalidation: RBA holds at 4.60% or delivers dovish guidance.

pair_paths.rationale: AUD was weakest at -0.351%, room for hawkish repricing.
